messages:
Emma: Thinking out loud — what if we run a hands-on micro-workshop instead of a straight webinar? Short lecture + live lab: “Cost-aware LLM features with Redwood Optimize.” Target: product + infra engineers.
Mike: love that. demo idea? show 3 configs: hosted, dedicated, private and cost/latency tradeoffs + quick overlay of batching/quantization. 20min demo?
Anya: +1. Need an abstract we can use for registration page. short + benefit-driven. who wants to own speaker notes?
Emma: I can draft abstract. draft idea: "Ship LLM features that stay fast and affordable — practical knobs (batching, kv caching, quantization) and an interactive lab to try them." keep <= 2 lines.
Li: I'll cover the workload profiling piece (how to pick batching & cache). 6–8 min. Can we show perf numbers with real traces?
Carlos: I'll own demo infra and the failover demo (model fallback to quantized variant). also can prepare a small traffic replay. Need creds for sandbox.
Emma: perfect. rehearsal plan: 1) 10m intros/platform overview 2) 20m live lab (split into 3 mini exercises) 3) 15m case study + numbers 4) 15m Q&A. total 60m. thoughts?
Mike: seems tight. suggest 5m for housekeeping + 40m lab + 10m q. participants should pick 1 of 3 lab tracks.
Anya: agree — keep one track for embeddings + reranking (common prod pattern).
Li: can we build short starter repos for each track and host on GH? i'll spin them up and add README steps.
Carlos: for demo safety, include a fallback slide: if the live model chokes, we swap to recorded run and explain differences. ops-bot can announce deployment status during rehearsal.
Zach (deploy-bot): Automated note: rehearsal env will be created at 2024-12-05T15:00Z if requested via /create-workshop.
Emma: scheduling: target date 2025-01-22 16:00 PT. rehearsal window: 2025-01-15 or 2025-01-20. who can make those?
Mike: 1/20 good for me. 1/15 travels.
Anya: 1/20 works.
Li: 1/15 preferred but can 1/20.
Carlos: 1/20 good.
Emma: OK lock 1/20 for full rehearsal. ops, please book 60m plus 30m tech check.
Carlos: inbound lead routing: set post-webinar form to tag leads by track and product interest (Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private). Add 'request demo' checkbox that routes to AE queue.
Mike: sequencing of launch posts — short LinkedIn pulse day-of, repo + tutorial within 48h, on-demand recording + assets within week. we'll craft the narrative around "cost vs. quality controls you can actually ship."
Anya: need two teaser blurbs: 1-line social + 3-line landing copy. I'll draft and post for review by Friday.
Emma: speaker asks: 1) short bio + headshot 2) 3 bullet talking points 3) demo runbook w/ fallback steps — please drop by end of week.
Li: sending bio + bullets now.
Carlos: demo runbook: adding basic playbook to repo: 
```
# runofshow snippet
# 1. start replay tool
# 2. verify model variants loaded
# 3. start traffic at 10rps
# 4. if latency > 400ms -> switch to quantized variant
```
Emma: nice. ops will convert that to the rehearsal checklist.
Zach (deploy-bot): Reminder scheduled: rehearsal reminder 2025-01-18 09:00 PT -> all participants.
Mike: anyone objections to a short pre-webinar survey to capture attendee infra scale? helps tailor followups.
Anya: good idea. keep 3 questions.
Emma: timeline summary: draft landing + abstract by Friday, assets + repos by 12/20, rehearsals 1/20, webinar 1/22. I'll put a calendar invite.
Carlos: thumbs up. I'll load the demo env and post access by EOD next Wed.
Emma: sweet. tagging @product for alignment and @sales for routing FYI. :rocket:
Mike: :thumbsup:
Anya: :raised_hands:
